_comment: Gameplay tips shown on the loading screens (scripts/LoadScreen.cs), one picked at random and rotated every few seconds.
tips: A dodge roll leaves you untouchable for a heartbeat. Roll through a swing, not away from it.
Raise your guard just as a blow lands to parry it: the foe staggers and its stance breaks wide open.
Every foe has a stance. Keep the pressure on and it breaks, leaving it open to a heavy strike.
Heavy attacks are slow to start but stagger most foes. Save them for the opening after a parry.
Lock on to a single foe to circle it. Locking on keeps the camera steady when several close in.
Rolling, sprinting and swinging all spend stamina. An empty bar leaves you slow and open.
Wands fire quick bolts and cost little mana. Staves are slower, but their spells hit far harder.
Spellcraft lets you shape your own spells: pick a form, an element and the runes that change them.
Mana returns slowly in a fight. Carry blue potions into a dungeon and drink them between foes.
Equip a pickaxe and press the build key to raise and break blocks. Walls and stairs are only a few swings away.
Stone, ore and timber gathered in the wilds become blocks to build with, or the makings of better gear.
Craft at a forge or workbench in town. Better materials from deeper floors make stronger weapons.
Dungeons grow harder with every floor you descend, and so does their loot. Every fifth floor starts a new tier.
Set gear only drops deep in its own dungeon. Wear several pieces of one set for its bonus.
Raid lairs hold the cruellest bosses. Bring a party: a fallen ally can be raised where they lie.
Shift between the Light and the Shadow. Some foes, paths and treasures exist in only one realm.
Discovered places can be reached by fast travel from the map, as long as nothing is hunting you.
Call your mount for long journeys. You cannot fight from the saddle, so dismount before the battle.
The skill tree grows with every level. Points can be spent on raw power or on the passives that shape a build.
Status effects stack: burning, poison and bleeding wear a boss down while you keep out of reach.
On a gamepad, the menus follow the d-pad and both sticks; every screen can be played without a mouse.
Gamepad: hold the guard trigger to block and tap it on impact to parry. The right stick turns the camera.
The Crimson Arena pays in valor. Survive more waves for a richer reward, or leave between waves to keep it.
Your hero rests where you last saved. Die in the wilds and you wake there, gear intact.
Torches and lanterns placed as blocks light the dark. Dungeons are kinder with a light behind you.
Water slows you, ice sends you sliding and lava burns. Read the ground before you fight on it.
